title: Thank you from all of us at Azure Cosmos DB Conf 2025!
content: That's a wrap for Azure Cosmos DB Conf 2025. We appreciate your continued support and look forward to sharing more great Azure Cosmos DB content for you in the future. Please head to the agenda page to see all of the recorded sessions from the event. We hope to see you at Azure Cosmos DB Conf 2026!

title: Live and On-Demand Agenda Now Available
content: We’re excited to share that our complete live and on-demand agenda is now available! Head over to our agenda page to browse all the sessions, speaker details, and schedules.

title: Azure Cosmos DB Conf 2025 Blog Announcement
content: The official Azure Cosmos DB blog has published the announcement for Azure Cosmos DB Conf 2025. Read the blog post to see what’s planned and how to register for free.

title: Our Sizze Reel is Live!
content: Hear from the Microsoft team why you should join as at Azure Cosmos DB Conf 2025. Watch the Sizzle Reel to get a sneak peek of what’s in store!

title: Meet the Speakers
content: Get ready to meet the incredible lineup of speakers joining us for Azure Cosmos DB Conf 2025! Check out the speaker list and see who’s presenting this year.

title: Session Agenda Coming Soon
content: The full session agenda is almost here! Stay tuned for a detailed schedule featuring live and on-demand content. View the agenda as it updates.

title: Keynote Speaker Revealed
content: Kirill Gavrylyuk, VP of Azure Cosmos DB, will deliver the keynote, sharing exciting announcements and the future of AI-driven databases.

title: Azure Cosmos DB Conf 2025 CFP Closed!
content: Azure Cosmos DB Conf 2025 Call for Papers (CFP) is now closed. Thank you to all who submitted their proposals!
